versions.changelog:
- Added a registration and API key acquisition guide with an invite link to the documentation.
- No functional or interface changes; documentation-only update.

- Initial release of pincaimao-resume-optimize.
- Enables automatic resume optimization or rewriting based on a target job description using the Pincaimao API.
- Requires PCM_RESUME_OPTIMIZE_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Supports uploading resume files and invoking API for formatted resume output.
- Provides both structured and raw output display options.
- Security: only communicates with api.pincaimao.com; no data stored outside this platform.
